limitations: Validation covers the recorded conditions and durations, not a full flight envelope.
FlightGear Nasal, electrical/hydraulic/FCS and shader programs are not executed; generic host controls and supported snapshot properties are used.
Rotation/translation animation is supported; other animation XML is retained. Near LOD is selected at conversion.
Source-specific materials/liveries can use approximations. Unnamed nozzles use explicitly marked geometry-projected attachment estimates.
